purpose: Candidate historical preseason context sources for the next native projection challenger.

candidates.coverage: weekly depth charts back to 2001; current format includes timestamped daily snapshots and preseason dates
candidates.historical_preseason_use: For each target season, select only the latest depth-chart record demonstrably available before regular-season opening. Never use later in-season revisions.
candidates.strength: Directly addresses the role-information gap identified by the FFToday benchmark.
candidates.rights_note: The nflverse-rosters code repository is MIT licensed, but code licensing must not be treated as automatic permission for every underlying data field/source. Depth-chart data source changed after 2024; verify dataset/source terms before commercial production use.

candidates.historical_preseason_use: Use only a target-season snapshot/row that can be tied to a pre-Week-1 state; do not infer preseason status from later weekly rows.
candidates.strength: Potentially supplies target-team and active/reserve context with GSIS identifiers for clean joins.

priority: Depth-chart role context first, especially QB, because the external benchmark showed the largest and most stable native gap at QB.
